deck.title: LocalModel Hub — AI that never leaves your device

props.title: AI that ==never leaves== your device.
props.subtitle: A full AI chat that runs entirely in your browser — on your own GPU. No servers. No accounts. No trace.
props.foot: Mike Demo · Bolt Builder Week · October 2026

slides.notes: Open with the promise: everything you type stays on the machine you're sitting at. Live demo is at privatebrain.app.

props.title: Every prompt you type ==leaves your machine.==
props.body: Cloud AI chat sends each message to someone else's server — a privacy cost most people pay without noticing. For sensitive thinking, it's a non-starter.

slides.notes: Make it personal: drafts, health questions, work secrets — all of it currently travels to a third party. Pause before moving on.

props.title: A full AI chat, ==100% on your device.==
props.name: LocalModel Hub

messages.text: Summarize these private notes. Nothing gets uploaded, right?
Right — I'm running on your device's GPU. This conversation never touches a server.
After the model downloads once, I keep working. Airplane mode included.

slides.notes: The chat on screen is the product shape: familiar AI chat, but the model lives in the browser tab. Download once, then conversations happen entirely on-device.

props.title: A real LLM, running ==in the tab.==

items.title: WebLLM + WebGPU
items.body: A real language model runs locally in the browser, accelerated by the device's own GPU.

items.title: Pick your model
items.body: Choose one sized to your hardware — from lightweight to full-size open models.

items.title: Download once
items.body: The model caches on your device. After that first download, no connection needed.

items.title: Chat anywhere
items.body: Offline-capable and private by default. Your history lives only on your machine.

slides.notes: Keep it light on tech: WebLLM and WebGPU make in-browser inference real. The only network moment is the one-time model download.

left.label: Cloud AI
left.title: Privacy is a promise
points: Every chat lives on their servers
Trust the provider's policy — and its vendors
A breach, subpoena, or leak exposes everything

right.label: LocalModel Hub
right.title: Privacy is structural
points: There is no chat server to breach
Nothing to subpoena, nothing to leak

slides.notes: The key line of the deck: cloud privacy depends on someone else's behavior; ours depends on the absence of a server. Structural, not contractual.
